title: ECoG hemispheric asymmetry during reaching (Merrick et al. 2022): authors' 1000 Hz intracranial exports with reach kinematics
description: Intracranial ECoG recordings from six patients with intractable epilepsy implanted with subdural grids over the left (n=3) or right (n=3) hemisphere, collected while they performed an instructed-delay reaching task with each arm. The release contains the authors' 1000 Hz neural exports together with reach kinematics, supporting analysis of hemispheric asymmetry in the encoding of bilateral arm movements. It is a BIDS repackaging of the authors' public Zenodo release.
methods_description: Recordings were made at UC Irvine (Nihon Kohden, 5000 Hz), UCSF (Tucker Davis Technologies, 3052 Hz) and California Pacific Medical Center (Nihon Kohden, 1000 Hz). Signals not recorded at 1000 Hz were low-pass filtered at 500 Hz and downsampled to 1000 Hz. Patients performed an instructed-delay reaching task on a touchscreen, with two blocks of 40 trials per arm in counterbalanced order. Kinematics are provided at 100 Hz.
